lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p2 - Listen and point. Do the actions.

details:
Listen and point allows students to practise sound–meaning matching. Pointing confirms accurate identification of the words they hear.
Do the actions checks understanding by asking students to mimic the actions they hear and see.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing and joining in with the appropriate actions.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p32 - Find the difference

details: Find the difference checks recognition of simple action words by comparing two pictures with small changes.
Look for accurate identification of actions (jump up, sit down, clap), correct reference to each picture, and spotting all of the differences.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

details: Point & say reinforces recognition of action words by linking them to a visual prompt. Saying supports accurate sound production and strengthens early letter–word associations.
Look for accurate pointing to actions, and clear pronunciation of target vocabulary.
